tool_material: Machined smooth tooling or validated precision-printed/sealed tooling with a compatible release agent
process: Use two 3 mm x 8 mm registration pins and four M3 clamp fasteners per mold.
Wet the open cavities with degassed Dragon Skin 10 Slow, close the registered halves evenly and let surplus material escape through the side channels.
Follow the current material mixing and cure instructions; first check inhibition and release on a small coupon.
Trim side flash without cutting the sealing foot or foil-neck port; measure the finished cover and fitting-base dimensions.
limits: Nominal tooling geometry does not establish cure, shrinkage, demolding, adhesion or skin life.
The 0.10 mm nail cover and 0.08 mm overflow features require a qualified precision process.
Actual M3 bolt length depends on the exported blank width and the chosen washers/nuts.
